test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: There are seven row houses M, N, O, P, Q, R and S in a campus but not necessarily in the same sequence. P is not at any of the ends. R is to the immediate right of P. S is third from the left. O is at the left end. M is second from the right. O is not beside N. Where is N located?
solution:
Persons: M, N, O, P, Q, R and S

1) S is third from the left.

2) O is at the left end.

3) M is second from the right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39897d5d9d068be2bb2a46374d5a88d35bc68926898acf47b017a27bf6c976c3.png] 

4) P is not at any of the ends.

5) R is to the immediate right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ca026b0eaaf9dffb18f1e1dc7c0548ebf51ec671065467d630f62a2ad3d4aae.png] 

6) O is not beside N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44bea3fba2e3ff560cb3376a3dc2a1fce3b6aaeb75c9be6310d5bb301ed6bc34.png] 

**Hence, N is located “at the right end”.**
